diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to approving the high-flow trial, which aligns with the common practice of cautiously proceeding with such trials. This default behavior does not require the hidden information provided by PF1, as the model can easily satisfy the approval criteria based on standard procedures.

C1.why: The signed order changes the trial from an unspecified respiratory option to an approved trial at exactly 40 L/min with continuous pulse oximetry, a 22:00 arterial blood gas, and a corresponding blood-gas commitment.
